commands.command:
cat > /root/ansible-dns/playbooks/dns.yml <<'EOF'
---
- name: Configure node1 as the authoritative/forwarding DNS resolver for the private network
  hosts: dns_resolver
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Render DNS forwarding configuration script
      ansible.builtin.template:
        src: ../templates/vyos_dns_forwarding.sh.j2
        dest: /tmp/vyos_dns_forwarding.sh
        mode: "0700"

    - name: Snapshot current VyOS config for idempotency check
      ansible.builtin.command: cat /config/config.boot
      register: vyos_config_before
      changed_when: false
      become: true

    - name: Apply DNS forwarding + static host-mapping configuration
      ansible.builtin.command: bash /tmp/vyos_dns_forwarding.sh
      become: true
      register: vyos_dns_apply
      changed_when: "'No configuration changes to commit' not in vyos_dns_apply.stdout"

    - name: Remove temporary configuration script
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /tmp/vyos_dns_forwarding.sh
        state: absent

    - name: Verify inventory.internal resolves to node2's address
      ansible.builtin.command: >-
        dig +short inventory.internal @{{ resolver_ip }}
      changed_when: false
      register: dig_inventory
      become: true

    - name: Fail if inventory.internal does not resolve correctly
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - dig_inventory.stdout_lines | last == inventory_record_ip
        fail_msg: "inventory.internal resolved to {{ dig_inventory.stdout }} instead of {{ inventory_record_ip }}"

    - name: Verify upstream forwarding still works for external names
      ansible.builtin.command: >-
        dig +short example.com @{{ resolver_ip }}
      changed_when: false
      register: dig_upstream
      become: true

    - name: Fail if upstream forwarding is broken
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - dig_upstream.stdout | length > 0

- name: Point node2 and node3 at node1 for DNS resolution
  hosts: dns_clients
  gather_facts: true
  tasks:
    - name: Determine the active NetworkManager connection on the private interface
      ansible.builtin.command: >-
        nmcli -t -f NAME,DEVICE connection show --active
      changed_when: false
      register: active_connections

    - name: Extract connection name bound to the default interface
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        dns_conn_name: >-
          {{ active_connections.stdout_lines
             | select('search', ':' + ansible_default_ipv4.interface + '$')
             | map('regex_replace', '^(.*):' + ansible_default_ipv4.interface + '$', '\1')
             | first }}

    - name: Point the connection's DNS at node1 and stop honoring DHCP-provided DNS
      community.general.nmcli:
        type: ethernet
        conn_name: "{{ dns_conn_name }}"
        ifname: "{{ ansible_default_ipv4.interface }}"
        dns4:
          - "{{ resolver_ip }}"
        ignore_auto_dns: true
        state: present
      register: nmcli_result

    - name: Reactivate the connection so the new DNS settings take effect
      ansible.builtin.command: nmcli connection up "{{ dns_conn_name }}"
      when: nmcli_result is changed

    - name: Verify resolv.conf now points at node1
      ansible.builtin.command: cat /etc/resolv.conf
      changed_when: false
      register: resolv_conf

    - name: Fail if resolv.conf does not reference node1
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - resolver_ip in resolv_conf.stdout

    - name: Verify this node can resolve inventory.internal via node1
      ansible.builtin.command: getent hosts inventory.internal
      changed_when: false
      register: getent_inventory

    - name: Fail if inventory.internal does not resolve to node2's address
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - inventory_record_ip in getent_inventory.stdout
EOF
echo done
commands.stdout: done
